description: This file is a Smarty plugin that generates HTML buttons for various actions within the SugarCRM framework. It handles creating different types of form buttons such as Save, Cancel, Delete, Duplicate, and custom buttons, with specific behaviors and JavaScript integrations tailored for SugarCRM views and subpanels.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_button
methods.description: Main function that generates different HTML buttons based on parameters such as type, module, view, and optional JavaScript behaviors. Supports built-in button types like Save, Cancel, Delete, and others, including custom code and HTML snippets.

methods.name: replaceFormClick
methods.description: Helper function that modifies DOM trees of HTML snippets to replace form-related JavaScript callbacks, enabling buttons to correctly submit forms within SugarCRM's dynamic UI framework.

methods.name: extractHiddenInputs
methods.description: Recursive function that extracts hidden input fields from a DOM tree to ensure hidden form fields are preserved and correctly appended when rendering custom HTML buttons.
